{{Quote|Admiral! We have enemy ships in sector 47!''"<br />"''It's a trap!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Verrack and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
'''Verrack''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] computer technician and specialist who held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]].

==Biography==
Verrack's expertise in power systems was greatly appreciated as well as needed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. In addition to his technical skills, Verrack also had experience as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].<ref name="Customizable Card Game" /> He served aboard [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], sitting behind [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] at one of the bridge consoles.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Following the Battle of Endor, Verrack was promoted [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Maria (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Maria'']], in the [[New Republic Third Fleet]]. He destroyed [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Peccati Syn|Syn's]] [[Silooth (Star Destroyer)|''Silooth'']] during the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Admiral, we have enemy ships at Sector RT-23 and PB-4.|A Mon Calamari controller.|<ref name="ROTJ Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>}}
Verrack first appeared as an unnamed Mon Calamari controller in the [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]] written by [[James Kahn]] and published on [[May 12]], [[1983]].<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> He would makes his screen debut in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], though with slightly altered lines.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Verrack later received a name and a quick backstory in the ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]], released in [[July]] [[2000]].<ref name="Customizable Card Game" />
